::: {.content-visible when-format="docx"}
# Book_20 — OrgPath and Privileged Access Management
:::


::: {.callout-note}
Privileged access is the surface where a single misconfigured vault safe, an over-permissioned admin account, or an unrotated service account password can become the entry point for a breach that crosses every boundary in the environment. Entra PIM governs eligible role activation for Entra-native resources, but it does not vault credentials, record privileged sessions, rotate service account passwords, or reach any non-Entra target — leaving the majority of the privileged attack surface ungoverned at the identity layer. This book incorporates CyberArk Privilege Cloud as UIAO's PAM surface under the Active Governance enforcement-adapter contract, with OrgPath position as the authorization spine: every vault safe, rotation policy, and session-brokering rule is addressed in the same fifteen-facet terms that govern every other surface in the substrate.
:::

## Companion canon

For the normative specifications this narrative paraphrases:

- [ADR-092 — Active Governance](/docs/adr/adr-092-active-governance.html) — the control-plane/data-plane boundary, provider-incorporation contract, and L0–L4 actuation maturity ladder that govern how CyberArk is incorporated.
- [OrgPath Codebook](/customer-documents/reference-architecture/codebook.html) — the fifteen-facet Model C schema (`UIAO_151`, `ADR-078`) whose facets drive privileged access scoping and safe membership.
- [Delegation Matrix — Appendix D](/customer-documents/reference-architecture/delegation-matrix.html) — the Org Position → AD Administration Role mapping (`UIAO_154`) that is the authorization model for privileged access by OrgPath position.
- [Drift Walk-through](/customer-documents/reference-architecture/drift-walkthrough.html) — the typed five-class drift taxonomy (`UIAO_163`, `ADR-040`) applied to privileged credential lifecycle reconciliation.
- [Architecture Decision Records](/docs/adr/index.html) — the binding record; this book is governed primarily by `ADR-092`, `ADR-078`, `ADR-040`, `ADR-038`, `ADR-035`, and `UIAO_154`.
